OR( ISCLONE(), ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Account__c), ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Opportunity2__c) ),
OR( ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__c), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Opportunity2__c), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__Opportunity2__c)), SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.AccountId <> SBQQ__Account__c ) ) )
